title: 第3章 薛仙仙
content_zh:
沈翔盘坐在地上，集中精神力，等待神脉挪到他的身上。

白幽幽和苏媚瑶把纤手按在沈翔的腹部上，只见她们的玉手分别冒出了一百一黑的雾气，黑色是白幽幽的至阴神脉，白色是苏媚瑶的至阳神脉，看起来非常神异。

沈翔身体中出现了一白一黑好像气流的东西，在他体内的肌肉、骨骼、经脉中游走，循环流动起来，他的经脉正在慢慢变大，骨骼和肌肉得到了强化，无数次循环之后，最后那一白一黑的气流汇聚在他的丹田之中形成一副太极阴阳图，这就是阴阳神脉！

苏媚瑶和白幽幽看见沈翔成功融合至阴至阳两条神脉，都不由得动容，心中兴奋不已，她们原本还以为至阴至阳两条神脉难以相融，而她们也抱着尝试的形态在沈翔身上实验，但没想到却成功了。

苏媚瑶和白幽幽慢慢后退，看着身上冒着一百一黑气雾的沈翔，她们不约而同的用一种复杂而惊讶的眼神对视着。在她们师姐妹的认知中，拥有阴阳两条神脉的人从未有过，此时她们能知道眼前这个毛头小子只要得到栽培，说不定能成为一个举世无双的强者。

沈翔睁开了眼睛，此时他有一种从未有过的舒爽，而且他觉得自己好像变强了一点。

“这就是神脉吗！感觉真好，我以后能进入真武境吗？”沈翔有些激动地说道，脸上闪现出一抹邪异的笑容，看起来坏坏的，根本没有之前那副憨厚老实的模样，这让那两个美人儿心中有些担忧。

这武道世界中，凡武境是最初的境界，分为炼气、淬体、武体、通脉、真气、神识、真罡、神力、真形、大圆满十个境界。

而在凡武境之上，还有真武之境，那是许多武者梦寐以求的境界，到达那个境界，能拥有翻江倒海之力，更是有千年的寿元。

沈翔就在就被卡在第三重的武体境，一直无法迈入四重的通脉境。

“才真武境？这简直就是辱没了神脉。”白幽幽不屑地冷哼道。

苏媚瑶脸色严肃，说道：“你拥有了阴阳神脉，眼界就要更加开阔一些！这个世界中力量是无止尽的，而且有着众多不同的世界，你现在所在的这个辰武大陆只是凡俗世界中一片小陆地而已！”

“你可要记得契约，你得帮助我们恢复到巅峰的实力！这可不是简单是事情！”

沈翔重重地点头道：“只要我还活着，我就一定会履行契约，替两位姐姐恢复巅峰的实力。”

白幽幽满意地说道：“帮助我们恢复实力的最快途径就是依靠丹药，当然，那是非常高等的丹药！等我们恢复实力之后，我们的契约也算搭成，到时候我们会去找我们仇敌复仇。”

沈翔觉得有些失落，如果这两个绝世美人能一直呆在他身边，那才是天大的享受。

苏媚瑶从她那头美丽的秀发中取出一枚戒指，她抛给沈翔，说道：“滴血认主，就和使用那种储物袋一样。把我和师姐装进去，然后你自己爬上去！这下面不能久留，这里是巨型妖兽经常出没的地方。”

鲜血滴入，沈翔立即和那戒指建立了联系，戒指里面的空间很小，只有一个房间大，在沈翔的认知中，传说中的储物戒指应该有辽阔如海的空间才对。

能装活物的储物法宝！这让沈翔惊叹不已，普通的储物袋都十分难得了，那都是从仙山中那些门派流传出来的，更别说装活物的储物法宝。

他照苏媚瑶的话去做，把两女收入储物戒指。他带上戒指之后，戒指竟然还能隐形在他的手指上，让沈翔暗暗称奇。

随后拿出他父亲给的丹药吃下，有了充足的体力，便开始攀爬悬崖峭壁，离开这死气充斥的深渊，这对他来说是一个巨大的挑战。

攀爬悬崖的过程让沈翔十分郁闷，因为他在黑色的死气中什么都看不到，加大了难度。

艰苦攀爬了一天一夜之后，沈翔终于爬了上来，原本他还以为这是难以完成的事情，但却因为有神脉的缘故，在攀爬上来时，摄取了许多灵气入体，清除他体内的疲劳，让他每时每刻都龙精虎猛。

沈翔爬上去之后，踏上了回家的路。

他无法看见那戒指里面的白幽幽和苏媚瑶，不过他却可以感应得到她们。

“两位姐姐，你们什么时候能传授我神功和魔功？”沈翔心急着问道，对于那些神功魔功他都很好奇。

“你的身体太弱，还不能修炼我的魔功。”白幽幽冰冷的声音传来。

苏媚瑶说道：“我的神功随时都可以修炼，你回到你的住所再开始修炼吧，到时候我还会教你炼丹制药。”

南武国，南方的卧虎城，人口百万，这是一座繁荣而巨大的城市，里面还坐落着一个南武国有名的武道世家，沈家！

沈家有着数千年的历史，至今的实力依然强大，底蕴丰厚，能屹立不倒数千年，就证明沈家的强大。

沈家富可敌国，是卧虎城里面最强大的势力，光沈家山庄就占地数千亩，山庄里面庭院无数，花园众多，有山有水，即便有人想潜入沈家，也会在里面迷路的。

天虎园，从名字来看，就知道这是沈天虎的府邸，作为沈家地位显赫的人，有一座巨大的宅院也是很正常的事情。

“老爹，我回来了！”沈翔一回来，就急忙奔向书房，他知道他父亲在那里。

沈天虎呵呵笑道：“你这臭小子终于回来了，你可知道有个小美人在等你？你还记得薛家的小丫头吗？就是你的那个小妻子。”

沈翔眉头一皱，脑海中顿时浮现出一个粉雕玉琢的漂亮小丫头来，那是他五六岁时候的事情了。

“老爹……你是说薛仙仙？”沈翔问道，这是薛家的一个天之娇女，在她小时候曾经来沈家住过一段时间，当时沈翔整天和她玩耍，两人很玩得来，然后就订下了婚约。

沈天虎点了点头：“没错，那小丫头就在山庄里面，你刚刚走她就来了，她可是吵着要见你。”

沈天虎说完，微笑着看向窗外，沈翔也扭过头看去，只见院子外面正有一个长身玉立的女子走来。

女子长发披肩，全身白衣，头上带着金光发饰。见这女子一身装束宛如仙女一般,沈翔不禁看得发愣。那女子不过十四五岁年纪，肌肤胜雪，容貌秀丽，让人不可逼视。

少女透过窗子看见沈翔，娇美无比的脸庞满是欢喜，她娇喊道：“小翔哥！”

声音轻灵婉转，动人心魄，沈翔承认，这个少女虽是豆蔻年华，但无论是气质还是容貌，都能比肩在他戒指里面的那两个美人儿，更何况这少女还没发育完全。

沈翔咽着口水，干笑道：“真是女大十八变呀！想当年的小丫头竟然变成了小仙女。”

这少女就是薛家的天之娇女，薛仙仙。

“这丫头是我的未婚妻！”沈翔内心激动地喊着。

如果是以前的话，沈翔心中多少会有些疙瘩，因为他没有灵脉。但现在他有着阴阳神脉！只要给他时间，踏足武道巅峰绝不是空想。

薛仙仙浅浅一笑，脸颊一个可爱的小酒窝伴随着迷人的红晕浮现，看得沈翔又是一阵失神。

沈天虎大笑一声，拍了下沈翔的肩膀，说道：“你们好好叙叙旧。”

来到院子中，沈翔二话不说，挽着薛仙仙那娇柔无骨的玉手，就快步离开他父亲的视线，就好像他们小时候偷偷做坏事一样。

沈翔带着一个小仙女来到自己的宅院，一路上让羡煞许多沈家子弟。

“仙仙，你要在沈家呆多久？”沈翔嘻笑着抚摸薛仙仙脸上那可爱的小酒窝。

薛仙仙只是面露娇羞，轻声说道：“小翔哥，我和我爹爹路过卧虎城才来看看你的，所以不会呆多久。”

在小时候，薛仙仙是因为得了怪病才来卧虎城求医的，那时候薛仙仙的身体很虚弱，长得很瘦很小，在沈家和薛家都经常被人欺负，当时只有沈翔很照顾她，经常和她嬉闹。那段时间让她很开心，而且沈翔经常鼓励她，让她能坚强的与病痛争斗，还给了她几粒珍贵的丹药。

这些都被薛仙仙铭记在心，即便她知道沈翔没有灵脉，没有任何前途，她都决定要嫁给沈翔。

沈翔有些失落，他也十分喜欢薛仙仙，在小时候，家族确定沈翔没有灵脉之后，沈翔就没有什么玩伴，所以他和薛仙仙在一起也很开心。

“小翔哥，家族原本要让我和你解除婚约，但我不同意，所以他们让我和爹爹去药家和那个天才炼丹师见见面。”薛仙仙看见沈翔的脸色变了，便轻笑道：“放心吧，我死也不会嫁给药家那个家伙的，听说他很坏。”

薛仙仙十四五岁就有凡武境六重的实力，在整个南武国中确实天才中的天才了，而药家里面也有一个十六岁就能炼制出丹药的天才，在许多人眼中，他们才是最配的一对。

沈翔很淡定，他有阴阳神脉，还有两个来历不明的厉害女人指导他修炼，他有信心在短时间赶超那个最年轻的天才炼丹师。

沈翔咧嘴一笑，伸手摸了摸薛仙仙张绝俗淡雅的脸颊，笑道：“仙仙，你去了药家就说你有未婚夫了，他不服就让他来挑战我。”

看见沈翔如此自信，薛仙仙也非常欢喜，她踮起脚尖，亲吻了一下沈翔的嘴唇，然后垂着头，红着脸说道：“小翔哥，你要加油，我担心我的家族会不惜一切的拆散我们。”

说完，薛仙仙轻轻一掠，如燕一般掠出了院子，身法飘逸，而沈翔还傻愣愣的站在那里，脑海中不断重复着薛仙仙亲吻他嘴唇的那一瞬间。

沈翔舔了舔嘴唇，笑道：“这小丫头还真的长大了很多。”

Chen Xiang sat cross-legged on the ground, concentrated his energy, and waited for the divine veins to move to his body.

Bai Youyou and Su Meiyao pressed their slender hands on Shen Xiang's abdomen, and saw a hundred and one black mist coming out of their jade hands. The black was Bai Youyou's Zhiyin Divine Vein, and the white was Su Meiyao's Zhiyang Divine Vein. They looked very magical.

Something like air currents, one white and one black, appeared in Chen Xiang's body. It circulated and circulated in the muscles, bones, and meridians in his body. His meridians were slowly getting bigger, and his bones and muscles were strengthened. After countless cycles, the final white and black air currents gathered in his Dantian to form a Tai Chi Yin and Yang diagram. This was the Yin and Yang Divine Veins!

Su Meiyao and Bai Youyou couldn't help but be moved when they saw Chen Xiang's successful fusion of the Yin and Yang divine veins, and they were very excited. They originally thought that it was difficult for the Yin to Yang divine veins to fuse, and they also tried it on Shen Xiang with the intention of trying it, but they did not expect it to succeed.

Su Meiyao and Bai Youyou slowly backed away and looked at Chen Xiang, who was covered in black mist. They looked at each other with complicated and surprised eyes.In the knowledge of their sisters, there has never been a person with two divine veins of yin and yang. At this time, they can know that as long as the young boy in front of them can be cultivated, he may become an unparalleled strong man.

Chen Xiang opened his eyes. At this moment, he felt a sense of relief that he had never felt before, and he felt as if he had become a little stronger.

"Is this the Divine Vein! It feels so good. Can I enter the True Martial Realm in the future?" Chen Xiang said excitedly, with an evil smile flashing across his face. He looked naughty and not as honest as before, which made the two beauties a little worried.

In this world of martial arts, the ordinary martial realm is the initial realm, which is divided into ten realms: Qi refining, body tempering, martial body, channel connection, true energy, spiritual consciousness, true power, divine power, true form, and great perfection.

And above the mortal martial realm, there is the true martial realm, which is the realm that many warriors dream of. Once you reach that realm, you can have the power to overwhelm rivers and oceans, and you will have a thousand years of life.

Chen Xiang has been stuck in the third level of martial body realm and has been unable to enter the fourth level of Tongmai realm.

"The true martial arts realm? This is simply an insult to the divine veins." Bai Youyou snorted disdainfully.

Su Meiyao looked serious and said: "You have the Yin and Yang Divine Veins, and your horizons should be broader! The power in this world is endless, and there are many different worlds. The Chenwu Continent you are in now is just a small land in the mortal world!"

"You must remember the contract. You must help us return to our peak strength! This is not a simple matter!"

Chen Xiang nodded heavily and said: "As long as I am still alive, I will definitely fulfill the contract and restore the peak strength of the two sisters."

Bai Youyou said with satisfaction: "The fastest way to help us regain our strength is to rely on elixirs. Of course, they are very high-level elixirs! After we regain our strength, our contract will be considered complete, and then we will seek revenge from our enemies."

Chen Xiang felt a little disappointed. If these two peerless beauties could always stay by his side, it would be a great enjoyment.

Su Meiyao took out a ring from her beautiful hair. She threw it to Chen Xiang and said, "Recognizing the owner by dripping blood is just like using that kind of storage bag. Put me and senior sister in it, and then climb up by yourself! You can't stay down here for a long time, this is a place where giant monsters often hang out."

As the blood dripped in, Chen Xiang immediately established a connection with the ring. The space inside the ring was very small, only as big as a room. In Chen Xiang's understanding, the legendary storage ring should have a space as vast as the sea.

A storage magic weapon that can hold living things!This made Chen Xiang marvel. Ordinary storage bags were very rare. They were all handed down from the sects in the Immortal Mountain, let alone storage magic weapons that could hold living things.

He did as Su Meiyao said and put the two girls into the storage ring.After he put on the ring, the ring was still invisible on his finger, which made Chen Xiang secretly amazed.

Then he took out the elixir given by his father and took it. With sufficient strength, he began to climb the cliff and leave the abyss filled with death. This was a huge challenge for him.

The process of climbing the cliff made Chen Xiang very depressed, because he could not see anything in the black death aura, which made it more difficult.

After climbing hard for a day and night, Chen Xiang finally climbed up. Originally, he thought it was something difficult to accomplish, but because of his divine veins, he absorbed a lot of spiritual energy into his body when he climbed up, which cleared away the fatigue in his body and made him energetic every moment.

After Chen Xiang climbed up, he embarked on his way home.

He couldn't see Bai Youyou and Su Meiyao inside the ring, but he could sense them.

"Two sisters, when will you teach me the magical and demonic skills?" Chen Xiang asked anxiously. He was very curious about those magical and demonic skills.

"Your body is too weak to practice my magic skills." Bai Youyou's cold voice came.

Su Meiyao said: "My magical skills can be practiced at any time. You can go back to your residence and start practicing again. I will also teach you how to make elixirs and make medicine."

Nanwu Kingdom, Crouching Tiger City in the south, has a population of one million. This is a prosperous and huge city, and there is also a famous martial arts family in Nanwu Kingdom, the Shen family!

The Shen family has a history of thousands of years, and it is still strong and rich in heritage. The fact that it can stand for thousands of years proves the strength of the Shen family.

The Shen family is the most powerful force in Crouching Tiger City. The Shen family villa alone covers an area of ​​thousands of acres. There are countless courtyards and gardens in the villa, and there are mountains and water. Even if someone wants to sneak into the Shen family, they will get lost in it.

Tianhu Garden, judging from the name, it is known that this is Shen Tianhu's mansion. As a member of the Shen family with a prominent position, it is normal for him to have a huge mansion.

"Dad, I'm back!" As soon as Chen Xiang came back, he hurried to the study, knowing that his father was there.

Shen Tianhu chuckled and said: "You brat is finally back. Did you know that there is a little beauty waiting for you? Do you still remember the little girl from the Xue family? She is your little wife."

Chen Xiang frowned, and a beautiful little girl suddenly appeared in his mind. That happened when he was five or six years old.

"Dad...you mean Xue Xianxian?" Chen Xiang asked. This is a beautiful girl from the Xue family. She came to live with the Shen family for a while when she was a child. At that time, Chen Xiang played with her all day long. The two had a great time, and then they made an engagement.

Shen Tianhu nodded: "Yes, that little girl is in the villa. She came just after you left. She is clamoring to see you."

After Chen Tianhu finished speaking, he looked out the window with a smile. Chen Xiang also turned around and saw a tall and tall woman walking outside the yard.

The woman has long hair shawl, is dressed in white, and has a golden hair ornament on her head.Seeing that this woman was dressed like a fairy, Chen Xiang couldn't help but be stunned.The woman was only fourteen or fifteen years old. Her skin was as good as snow, and her appearance was so beautiful that no one could look at her.

The girl saw Chen Xiang through the window, her extremely beautiful face was full of joy, she shouted sweetly: "Brother Xiao Xiang!"

The voice was light and graceful, touching people's hearts. Chen Xiang admitted that although this girl was in her prime, her temperament and appearance were comparable to the two beauties in his ring, not to mention that this girl was not fully developed yet.

Chen Xiang swallowed his saliva and said with a dry smile: "What a woman's transformation! The little girl I thought back then turned into a little fairy."

This girl is the beloved daughter of the Xue family, Xue Xianxian.

"This girl is my fiancée!" Chen Xiang shouted excitedly in his heart.

If it were before, Chen Xiang would have felt a little confused because he had no spiritual veins.But now he has the yin and yang divine veins!As long as you give him time, reaching the pinnacle of martial arts is no longer a fantasy.

Xue Xianxian smiled lightly, and a cute dimple appeared on her cheek along with a charming blush, which made Chen Xiang feel absent-minded again.

Chen Tianhu laughed loudly, patted Chen Xiang on the shoulder and said, "You guys should have a good time catching up on the past."

When he came to the yard, Chen Xiang said nothing, took Xue Xianxian's delicate and boneless jade hand, and quickly left his father's sight, as if they secretly did bad things when they were children.

Chen Xiang brought a little fairy to his mansion, making many of the Shen family's children envious along the way.

"Xianxian, how long do you want to stay at the Shen family?" Chen Xiang smiled and touched the cute dimples on Xue Xianxian's face.

Xue Xianxian just looked shy and said softly: "Brother Xiao Xiang, my father and I came to see you when we passed by Crouching Tiger City, so we won't stay long."

When she was a child, Xue Xianxian came to Crouching Tiger City for medical treatment because she had a strange disease. At that time, Xue Xianxian was very weak and very thin. She was often bullied in both the Shen family and the Xue family. At that time, only Chen Xiang took good care of her and often played with her.That period of time made her very happy, and Chen Xiang often encouraged her to fight the illness strongly, and also gave her a few precious pills.

Xue Xianxian kept all of this in mind. Even though she knew that Chen Xiang had no spiritual veins and no future, she decided to marry Chen Xiang.

Chen Xiang was a little disappointed. He also liked Xue Xianxian very much. When he was a child, after his family determined that Chen Xiang had no spiritual veins, Chen Xiang had no playmates, so he was very happy with Xue Xianxian.

"Brother Xiao Xiang, the family originally wanted me to terminate our engagement with you, but I didn't agree, so they asked me and my father to go to the Yao family to meet the genius alchemist." Seeing Chen Xiang's expression change, Xue Xianxian chuckled and said, "Don't worry, I will never marry that guy from the Yao family. I heard he is very bad."

Xue Xianxian was already at the sixth level of the Mortal Martial Realm when he was fourteen or fifteen years old. He was indeed the genius among geniuses in the entire Nanwu Kingdom. There was also a genius in the Yao family who could refine elixirs at the age of sixteen. In the eyes of many people, they were the most suitable couple.

Chen Xiang was very calm. He had the Yin and Yang Divine Veins and two powerful women of unknown origin to guide him in his cultivation. He was confident that he could catch up with the youngest genius alchemist in a short time.

Chen Xiang grinned, stretched out his hand to touch Xue Xianxian Zhang Juesu's elegant cheek, and said with a smile: "Xianxian, when you go to the Yao family, tell him that you have a fiancé. If he doesn't accept it, let him challenge me."

Seeing that Chen Xiang was so confident, Xue Xianxian was also very happy. She stood on tiptoes and kissed Chen Xiang's lips. Then she lowered her head and said with a blushing face: "Brother Xiang, you have to work hard. I'm worried that my family will do anything to break us up."

After saying that, Xue Xianxian swept out of the yard with a gentle sweep, like a swallow, with graceful movements, while Chen Xiang still stood there stupidly, repeating in his mind the moment when Xue Xianxian kissed his lips.

Chen Xiang licked his lips and said with a smile: "This little girl has really grown up a lot."
